page_title: REI 1-0 LOR | Reims v Lorient 28/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Amadou Kone (Reims) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
90+2' Teddy Teuma (Reims) is about to take a corner kick.

90+1' Josh Wilson-Esbrand (Reims) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Amine Salama (Reims) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
87' Here comes a substitution. Amadou Kone (Reims) is brought on as a substitute for Amir Richardson.
87' William Still has decided to make a change. Maxime Busi (Reims) replaces Junya Ito.
84' 1 - 0 Goal! Josh Wilson-Esbrand (Reims) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
82' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Bassirou Ndiaye (Lorient). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
81' Yvon Mvogo (Lorient) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Bastien had an easy-decision to make.
81' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to William Still, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
81' William Still isn't happy on the touchline after referee Benoit Bastien shows him a yellow card.
79' Teddy Teuma (Reims) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
78' The substitution has been made. Reda Khadra (Reims) has replaced Thomas Foket.
76' Junya Ito (Reims) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ayman Kari (Lorient) is coming onto the pitch as Aiyegun Tosin cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
72' That's a well-taken pass by Junya Ito (Reims). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
70' Teddy Teuma (Reims) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Yvon Mvogo is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
69' Thomas Foket (Reims) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
66' Substitution. Marshall Munetsi did his best and is replaced by Amine Salama (Reims).
66' William Still decides to make a substitution. Thibault De Smet will be replaced by Josh Wilson-Esbrand (Reims).
65' Benoit Bastien shows a yellow card to Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) for his blatant foul.
64' The ball is cleared after Marshall Munetsi (Reims) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
61' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) was quite harsh and Benoit Bastien didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
60' A quickly taken corner by Lorient.
59' Junya Ito (Reims) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Eli Junior Kroupi departs the field of play to be replaced by Bassirou Ndiaye (Lorient).
56' Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.

55' Yehvann Diouf makes a brilliant save! Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper!
54' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar.
53' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Teddy Teuma (Reims), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
51' A spell of possession for Reims in an attempt to control the game.
49' Junya Ito (Reims) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
47' Junya Ito (Reims) sends a cross into the box, but Yvon Mvogo comes off his line to gather the ball.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The game is interrupted now, Marshall Munetsi (Reims) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
43' Junya Ito (Reims) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
41' Formose Mendy (Lorient) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
40' Looks like Formose Mendy (Lorient) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
39' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
37' Teddy Teuma (Reims) has tested the patience of referee Benoit Bastien and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
36' Romain Faivre (Lorient) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
34' Wasted opportunity! Teddy Teuma (Reims) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
32' Teddy Teuma (Reims) sends a chip pass into the box, but Yvon Mvogo is quickest to intercept the ball.
31' Thibault De Smet (Reims) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.

29' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Yvon Mvogo shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
28' Good defending. Thibault De Smet (Reims) tries to find Junya Ito inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
25' A long through ball into the box almost gives Mohamed Daramy (Reims) a good chance, but he loses out to one of the defenders.
23' Teddy Teuma (Reims) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

20' Amir Richardson (Reims) found himself in a promising position. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made a decent save.
18' Romain Faivre (Lorient) is penalised for a foul. Benoit Bastien had a clear view and blows his whistle.
15' Junya Ito (Reims) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
14' Teddy Teuma (Reims) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the left side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Yvon Mvogo makes a comfortable save.
12' Junya Ito (Reims) will take a corner kick.
9' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) has an effort from close range after latching on to a precise pass, but he can't beat one of the defenders who makes a good block.
9' An attempted cross from Thibault De Smet (Reims) is cleared.
7' Lorient have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
7' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) tries to find Theo Le Bris, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
3' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
1' The first half has just begun.
Lorient will kick the game off.
Benoit Bastien got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
